functional_requirements.description: Verify that Event Types list page loads and is accessible from the Setup/Configuration menu
Verify that a new Event Type can be created with valid data
Verify that an existing Event Type can be edited and updated successfully
Verify that an Event Type can be deleted and no longer appears in the list
Verify that Event Type name field is required and shows validation error when empty
Verify that duplicate Event Type names are not allowed and produce an appropriate error
Verify that Event Types appear correctly in downstream dropdowns and selectors
Verify search and filter functionality on the Event Types list
Verify that appropriate user role permissions are enforced for Event Type management
Verify UI/UX elements: correct labels, button states, and responsive layout

acceptance_criteria: Event Types list page loads without errors when navigated from Setup menu
Create Event Type form submits successfully with valid name and saves to list
Edit Event Type form pre-populates existing values and saves updates correctly
Delete action removes the Event Type from the list after confirmation
Empty name submission shows a required-field validation error
Duplicate name submission shows a duplicate-entry error
Created Event Types appear in downstream event-type selectors
Search/filter on the list narrows results correctly
Unauthorized users cannot access Event Type management
